verdict.rationale: Mangopay's e-wallet guide says platform fees are collected and automatically wired to the platform's bank account each month. Its wallet infrastructure supports splitting funds, which implies a platform fee can be taken on transactions, but no evidence describes how fees are configured. Missing for 10: documented per-transaction application fee/markup configuration, per-seller pricing, reporting that separates platform revenue from processing costs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, payments are a revenue line — take an application fee or markup on every transaction, set per-seller pricing, and see my payments revenue reported distinctly from processing costs

citations.quote: Your fees are automatically wired to your bank account every month.
Leverage Mangopay's wallet infrastructure to receive, hold, split, and transfer funds
